prompt: Quick reference questions about Keepa's data shape: (a) What does CSV index 18 contain? (b) What does it mean when a value in a price CSV is -1? (c) How is the rating field stored — what number do I divide by to get stars? (d) What is productType=5 and why does it matter? (e) For the BR (Brazil) marketplace, what domain ID would I pass to keepa_fetch_product?

assertions.name: csv_18_is_buy_box_shipping
assertions.description: (a) Identifies CSV index 18 as Buy Box price (with shipping) / BUY_BOX_SHIPPING

assertions.name: minus_one_means_unavailable
assertions.description: (b) Explains -1 means no offer / out of stock / unavailable at that timestamp

assertions.name: rating_divided_by_10
assertions.description: (c) Says rating is stored 0-50 and to divide by 10 for stars

assertions.name: productType_5_is_variation_parent
assertions.description: (d) Identifies productType=5 as a variation parent ASIN

assertions.name: explains_why_productType_5_matters
assertions.description: (d) Explains parent has no prices/rank/offers and child ASIN should be queried
